// source: Service kaboom-web. Root directory = repo root (npm workspaces); set the service's Railway config file path to /apps/web/railway.json. Build steps live in apps/web/Dockerfile (Node 22, npm ci + next build of @playkaboom/web only).

deploy.// preDeployCommand: Applies pending db/migrations before the new deployment takes traffic (idempotent, advisory-locked). Runs from WORKDIR apps/web.
deploy.// numReplicas: Pinned to 1: the cron passes run in-process (relay ticks /api/cron/tick every 60 s). The tick's advisory lock keeps passes from overlapping across replicas, but per-pass cadence lives in process memory and the rate limiter falls back to in-process without Upstash.
